title: Puck, front and centre
body: Your Puck now sits on every thread's message box, on Amp's Call Puck button. Hover it for Puck's latest update and Ask about this thread, which opens Puck with the thread's link ready. New thread (⌘N) starts with Puck too.

title: Serve a missing folder from the error
body: When a thread can't resume because this Mac's runner doesn't serve its folder, Amp's message gets a button that adds the folder to the runner.

title: ⌥-click Amp's own file and commit links
body: In threads that ran on this Mac, ⌥-click a file link to show it in Finder, or a commit link to open it on GitHub. A plain click still opens Amp's tab. Orb threads are unchanged.

title: Full titles on thread and artifact links
body: Links to other threads and artifacts in a reply are often cut short. Hover one to read its whole title.

title: What's new, in the Tweaks menu
body: New tweaks and changes show up here. The menu now says which tweaks work in Amp alone and which use this Mac.

title: Open files from threads on this Mac
body: In threads that ran on a runner on this Mac, file paths open in your editor, and ⌥-click shows them in Finder. Orb threads keep opening files in Amp's own tabs.

title: Quick replies
body: Suggested replies fold into one chip. Hover it to see them in full. When the agent is waiting on you, its question comes first.

title: Thread outline
body: Long threads get a list of what you asked down the right. It tucks into a rail beside images; hover the rail to bring it back.

title: Tweaks menu
body: Turn tweaks on and off from the button above your profile, instead of the terminal.
